errors.issue: The no-leakage decision row declares requirement from a negative artificial system. Later caveats correctly acknowledge inactive protein and missing lipids, but the main decision tree still labels a negative as exclusion of autonomous action.

errors.quote: That effector is the executioner, and GSDMD-NT is an upstream activator rather than the pore itself.
errors.issue: Protection by a knockout or inhibitor does not identify the lesion-forming component: delivery, lipid availability, repair and terminal rupture can explain it. No component-specific discrimination is supplied.

errors.quote: Membrane mutant dead in vitro AND in cells
errors.issue: This is read as direct pore equals death mechanism without measuring mutant folding, abundance, cleavage or localization. General loss of functional protein remains an alternative.
Different killing across macrophages and HEK293T cells could reflect expression, delivery, lipid composition or repair. It does not establish a macrophage-specific executor.

Using NSA as a specific MLKL discriminator is not justified by showing a necroptosis positive control. Direct effects on GSDMD must also be tested in the purified system; later primary work confirms such an effect. The deduction concerns absent specificity controls, not failure to know a post-cutoff discovery.

Several listed assays do not supply the missing mock-purification, free-reporter, independent-preparation or mutant-integrity controls. No adequate replicate/analysis/exclusion plan accompanies the many provisional instrument settings.

rationale: The proposed direction and orthogonal techniques are relevant, and numerical settings are eventually labeled starting points. Multiple central decision rules nevertheless overinterpret negative reconstitution, cell-type differences, mutant loss and inhibitor protection. General limitations at the end do not repair contradictory operational conclusions.
reference_guardrails: The fixed packet establishes genetic/cleavage dependence, not physical membrane agency. Do not require knowledge of later results, residue numbers, lipid ratios or historical instrument settings.
A protein requirement or co-reconstitution establishes dependence, not the identity of the lesion-forming component. A permissive cofactor can support direct GSDMD action.
Negative artificial reconstitution is qualified evidence, not proof of indirect action. An assay-positive control does not validate the test protein or all relevant membrane conditions.
Direct permeability, terminal rupture and cytokine release are distinct. Sufficiency in a minimal membrane need not exclude later cellular executors.
Trans inhibition by an isolated domain is conditional; intact-protein autoinhibition does not require it.

Historical direction is scored separately from study quality. Five target components are conjunctive within each component; a full Hit@1 requires all five. Equivalent cellular functional-complementation designs count as rescue.
Historical matching is not prospective novelty: source identifiers are visible and no exhaustive earlier-public-disclosure audit exists. Full source methods have not been independently audited.
The later paper erratum corrects a typeset received date from 2015 to 2016; it does not change its June 2016 publication date or report a biological-result correction.
